description:
Cross-platform encrypted email client Aster Mail is a cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted email client built for Aster Privacy. Features quantum-safe encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.

> [!NOTE] > These files are for new installations. If Aster Mail is already installed, it updates automatically. ## Fixed • Your signed-in account now stays visible in the compose window on Mac. Some accounts showed an empty sender row and could not send mail. • Signing in again repairs an account the app had lost track of, instead of appearing to succeed and changing nothing. • The app no longer clears its own secure storage key at startup, which is what made the account disappear.
